purpose: Historical claims below one kilometre mapped to predeclared DS1 comparison arms. Historical point error is descriptive only; DS1 performance is deliberately null until an arm is run.

ds1_reference.baseline: Causal cached TLE prediction; TRAIN-only visible-candidate reselection and constant per-track CFO; occupied-second weighting; 800 Hz cap; randomized inner held rows.
ds1_reference.current_nuisance: Either tau=0 or one global tau in [-5,5] seconds. No per-NORAD rate, per-scan time, track time, cone, beam, drift, or correlated likelihood.

techniques.mechanism: Calibrate each orbit timing at the configured receiver coordinate, then pool conditional scan fits.
techniques.historical_hyperparameters: Known configured site used during calibration; fixed height; pooled 19 scans.
techniques.truth_or_site_leakage: yes: orbit calibration used the answer, and the old configured coordinate is 1.29 km from the confirmed antenna
techniques.ds1_arm: none; retain only as a negative leakage control
techniques.reuse: Do not reuse fitting logic for an accuracy arm. Its corrected coordinate error is not sub-kilometre.

techniques.mechanism: One joint receiver UTC shift with robust position fit on fixed, site-selected identities.
techniques.historical_hyperparameters: tau in [-0.5,+0.5] s; quadratic state interpolation at -0.5, 0, +0.5 s; observation-balanced robust residuals.
techniques.truth_or_site_leakage: yes: identities are historical site-selected; absolute clock has no independent authority
techniques.ds1_arm: already_run: global shared-time versus tau=0, but DS1 reselects candidates at each point/tau rather than fixing site-selected IDs
techniques.reuse: DS1 reports/2026_09_24_ds1/run.py provides the transferable global-tau structure. Add a TRAIN-only fixed-ID control to isolate identity reselection from the time effect.

techniques.mechanism: Joint UTC with a 100 Hz cap and longest episode per satellite per scan.
techniques.historical_hyperparameters: Minimum support 15 s; cap in {100,200,500} Hz; longest-per-satellite selection; the 100 Hz + UTC variant retained 85 episodes.
techniques.truth_or_site_leakage: yes: it inherits identities from a prior continental run and the successful policy became visible after outcome comparison
techniques.ds1_arm: exclude from primary DS1; optional frozen TRAIN-only support-selection sensitivity after the primary models are sealed
techniques.reuse: The source whitelisting and selection-isolation tests are reusable. Do not import its policy winner or its historical identities.

techniques.mechanism: Causal TLE phase mean plus a signed, regularized phase-rate correction shared by each selected NORAD, with per-segment CFO offsets.
techniques.historical_hyperparameters: 446 fixed identities; rate bound +/-0.25 s/h; causal rate-prior sigma 0.09177 s/h; 250 Hz smooth robust scale; quadratic SGP4 state approximation at mean +/-1 s.
techniques.truth_or_site_leakage: site-conditioned fixed associations, but rate prior and fitting split are causal and reference is post-inference
techniques.ds1_arm: primary: causal prior plus a rate for every selected NORAD, reselected by the DS1 TRAIN-only scorer at every geographic point/time; compare global-tau-only, rate-only, and rate+global-tau. Also run a frozen-ID control.
techniques.reuse: Reuse FormalOrbitConfig phase-rate design and exact-state check. Write an adapter from DS1 track/candidate cache to FormalOrbitData; do not use the old 446-ID list.

techniques.mechanism: The same causal per-NORAD rate model with learned scale, AR(1) within-track whitening, and Student-t innovations.
techniques.historical_hyperparameters: AR(1) rho=0.65; Student-t df=4; nominal sigma=250 Hz with inferred sigma in [5,2000] Hz and log-prior width 1.5; phase-rate sigma=0.09176615913014215 s/h; rate bound +/-0.25 s/h.
techniques.truth_or_site_leakage: fixed identities inherited from full historical analysis; local model is otherwise causal and reference is post-seal
techniques.ds1_arm: after the rate-only DS1 arm: same rate data and candidate policy, first Gaussian independent learned-scale, then full AR(1)+Student-t learned-scale; select no likelihood setting by DS1 truth
techniques.reuse: Full research core is reusable after an input adapter. Historical ablation says rate removal caused 328.4->3137.1 m, correlation removal 920.6 m, fixed sigma 927.9 m, and Gaussian independent learned-scale 335.7 m.

techniques.mechanism: Joint continuous position over a conditional per-scan candidate union, individual integer track tau/CFO, plus exploratory timing and soft-association reranking.
techniques.historical_hyperparameters: 16 scans; candidate/tau support conditioned on prior Sacramento/Reno outputs; tau [-5,+5] s at 0.25 s; soft diagnostic used signal scale 250 Hz, null scale 30000 Hz, equal signal/null prior.
techniques.truth_or_site_leakage: yes: candidate union and seeds had historical evaluation exposure; some location ranking used recorded evaluation objective
techniques.ds1_arm: do not reproduce the exposed candidate pool or evaluation-ranked finalists. Use only its computational cache/search pattern with DS1's original candidate universe and TRAIN-only rank.
techniques.reuse: Reuse cached state interpolation, local geographic refinement and transparent candidate accounting. Do not reuse exposed candidate IDs, seed points, or evaluation selection.

techniques.mechanism: For each candidate, jointly profile continuous tau inside a cached 0.25 s interval and a constant track CFO.
techniques.historical_hyperparameters: tau [-5,+5] s; 0.25 s nodes; capped 800 Hz or pseudo-Huber 150 Hz track loss; 150 geographic evaluations.
techniques.truth_or_site_leakage: conditional candidate pool; no direct truth input to its sealed inference, but support is much wider than time authority
techniques.ds1_arm: diagnostic only: if run, constrain common scan tau to measured host/device brackets and compare with shared/global tau; never deploy independent +/-5s track tau as a primary estimator
techniques.reuse: Fractional interpolation and synthetic recovery tests are reusable. The historical result reversed from 2.920->0.631 km in one group and 1.042->3.741 km in the other.

techniques.mechanism: One bounded empirical epoch per scan, regularized around a global scan clock; fixed baseline identities and profiled track CFO.
techniques.historical_hyperparameters: tau [-5,+5] s; scales 0.2, 1, 5 s; best displayed arm 79 scans, scale 1 s.
techniques.truth_or_site_leakage: fixed local baseline identities; TRAIN-only result; scale varied by group and has no unopened validation/test transfer
techniques.ds1_arm: primary secondary: fixed-ID and reselected-ID variants, one global tau plus per-scan residual epoch; predeclare bracket-derived and 0.2/1.0 s scales, select scale only on DS1 TRAIN, then report both validation groups
techniques.reuse: The exact dynamic program/profiling helper is reusable, but map its tau grid to DS1 state cache and preserve DS1 randomized masks/track weights.

techniques.mechanism: Known-site-trained GLRT-margin response factor from RX0/RX1 directional asymmetry, combined with phase-aligned formal Doppler orbit fitting.
techniques.historical_hyperparameters: Three NORAD-mod-3 folds; one midpoint per pass; one global cable-map sign; five heading offsets over +/-10 degrees; 20 shuffled controls per fold; 200 km known-site local search.
techniques.truth_or_site_leakage: yes: beam calibration is trained at known site and includes same-window future captures
techniques.ds1_arm: excluded until independent RF gain/cable/heading calibration and a fixed phase-centre geometry are available
techniques.reuse: Keep the dual-receiver pairing and ambiguity-rejection diagnostics. Do not use GLRT-margin beam response in DS1 location fitting.

techniques.mechanism: Select native RX1 paths by coverage and add calibrated RX0 extensions to an anchor-excluded corpus.
techniques.historical_hyperparameters: 988-track site-conditioned corpus; calibration-anchor exclusion; native RX1 reference; quadratic orbit approximation.
techniques.truth_or_site_leakage: yes: candidate selection and local search are site-conditioned
techniques.ds1_arm: excluded as a position arm; optionally compare receiver-coverage extensions only after an exact-orbit and calibration-covariance-qualified baseline exists
techniques.reuse: The matched-anchor-exclusion bookkeeping is reusable for future receiver-fusion controls; receiver choice itself is confounded with coverage.

deliberately_not_promoted.reason: It did not produce a matched sub-kilometre result; it must remain an association-calibration diagnostic rather than be credited as the source of the 328 m result.
It did not produce a sub-kilometre held group and worsened complete validation-group position despite lower residuals.

required_common_ds1_gates: Preserve the frozen DS1 recording membership, original randomized masks, >=3 s track eligibility, occupied-second weights, and explicit full-TEST continuity failure.
Choose geographic position, candidate policy, nuisance model and hyperparameters from TRAIN only; use validation/test only after inference is sealed.

For every rate/timing arm, report position error, TRAIN and randomized held capped/uncapped RMS, selected candidates, nuisance-bound occupancy, exact SGP4 discrepancy, convergence/failure accounting and fixed-ID versus reselection sensitivity.
Treat reference error as evaluation, never as a model or hyperparameter selector. Do not claim physical clock or orbital attribution from empirical nuisance terms.
